- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.

⤨.name: swap
⤨.plain: a ⤨ b swaps cards at positions b / 5 and b % 5, counting from zero; an invalid position gives NaN.

⤺.name: rotate left
⤺.plain: a ⤺ moves every card one position left, wrapping the first position to the last.

↷.name: rotate right
↷.plain: a ↷ moves every card one position right, wrapping the last position to the first.

⥀.name: perm reverse
⥀.plain: a ⥀ reverses the positions of all cards.

∘.name: perm compose
∘.plain: a ∘ b moves each card by a first and then by b; the result at card i is b[a[i]].

⤾.name: perm inverse
⤾.plain: a ⤾ sends each card back to its original position; its value at i is the card at position i in a.

◎.name: perm apply
◎.plain: a ◎ b is the final position of card b under a; an invalid card number gives NaN.

≋.name: perm equal
≋.plain: a ≋ b is true exactly when both permutations send every card to the same position.
